column1: # builtins.tsv -- ONE BUILTIN TABLE (DESIGN-PLAN builtin-table step 1; ARCH-BUILTIN-TABLE.md section 3; CEO-2016): one row per builtin per vocabulary.

# bid     the row id, assigned once and NEVER renumbered or reused: the 186 ids of src/runtime/builtin_ids.h keep their numbers (one row per legacy name, the first vocabulary of sno icn pas rk rkm pl that spells it); a new row takes the next free id.

# vocab   sno (SNOBOL4; Snocone and Rebus lower through it) icn pas rk (a Raku sub or runtime helper) rkm (a Raku METHOD) pl. The harvest sorts a name by its spelling (SNO$ and ALL-CAPS and operators sno, $ pl, __pas_ pas, __rk_ rk, a lowercase name an Icon source spells icn, other lowercase rk); a name with two meanings becomes two rows when its language step finds them.
# min max arity bounds; max -1 is variadic; "-" means NO SOURCE STATES IT (nothing is invented; the language steps fill it as they write the leaves).
# entry   the C or asm symbol of the leaf; a name whose arm is not yet a separate function carries the entry it WILL have, bt_<name> (step 2 writes it); "-" for an inline row.
# conv    leaf | gen | open | inline (the harvest reading: gen for the generator lists, inline for the pas and pl leaf kinds, open for APPLY and EVAL, leaf for the rest).

# recv    rkm rows: the receiver class, * for every class (the harvest cannot see it).   flags: scan mut, "-" for none (the Icon scan rows belong to the scanning design).   op: the small integer one entry serves several rows with (g_bn_direct.op), else 0.
# src     the sources that name the row today (util_builtin_sources.py): dop_direct bn_direct icn_tbl icn_known icn_gen rt_known ids fn_arms meth_arms pas rk_targets pl_leaf.
